Edge Cases Test Page

This page tests various edge cases for field detection and stage detection.

Note: This page has no data-stage attribute. Stage detection will fall back to:
  1. URL parameter (e.g., ?stage=3 or /apply/step-3)
  2. Heading text matching "stage|step|page|part N"
  3. Default to stage "1" with low confidence

1. Iframe & Shadow DOM Notes

Iframe Note: Content scripts cannot access form fields inside cross-origin iframes due to Same-Origin Policy. If the application form is embedded in an iframe from a different domain, the content script will not detect those fields.

Shadow DOM Note: Fields inside closed Shadow DOM are not accessible via document.querySelectorAll. Open Shadow DOM can be pierced with element.shadowRoot.querySelectorAll, but this requires explicit handling. The current scanFields implementation only scans the main document's light DOM.

2. Aria-only Labels (No Visible Label)

These fields have no visible but use aria-label or aria-labelledby for accessibility.

3. Hidden Fields (Should Be Skipped)

These fields should be skipped by scanFields due to type="hidden" or CSS display:none.

4. Password Fields (Should Be Excluded)

Password fields are in SKIPPED_INPUT_TYPES and should be excluded.

5. Fields with Excluded Substrings (Should Be Skipped)

Fields whose label/name/id/placeholder contain excluded substrings (company, city, state, zip, postal, country, password, username) are skipped.

6. Other Excluded Input Types

These input types are in SKIPPED_INPUT_TYPES and should be excluded.
